facts.fact: In 2024, programmatic accounted for over 40% of digital political ad spend, according to the guide.
facts.quote: In 2024, programmatic accounted for over 40% of digital political ad spend.

facts.fact: Over 60% of U.S. households have cut traditional cable or never subscribed to it, per the guide.
facts.quote: Over 60% of U.S. households have cut traditional cable or never subscribed.

facts.fact: Voter file match rates for programmatic targeting typically range from 50% to 70%, depending on data quality and platform capabilities.
facts.quote: Match rates typically range from 50-70% depending on data quality and platform capabilities.

facts.fact: Most CTV inventory is non-skippable, with completion rates averaging 95% or higher, according to the guide.
facts.quote: Most CTV inventory is non-skippable, with completion rates averaging 95%+

facts.fact: The real-time bidding process from ad request to served ad takes approximately 100 milliseconds.
facts.quote: This entire process takes approximately 100 milliseconds

facts.fact: Adwave states that its platform has no minimum spend requirements for programmatic CTV campaigns.
facts.quote: Platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/pricing/) make CTV accessible to campaigns of all sizes, with no minimum spend requirements.

facts.fact: The guide describes programmatic budgets as flexible and starting from any amount, in contrast to traditional media's minimum spend requirements.
facts.quote: Flexible budgets starting from any amount

facts.fact: The guide describes the 2026 U.S. midterm elections as the planning horizon for campaign managers using programmatic advertising.
facts.quote: For campaign managers planning for the 2026 midterms, understanding programmatic advertising is essential.

facts.fact: Adwave recommends launching programmatic campaigns 6+ months before Election Day to begin testing creative and building audience data.
facts.quote: 6+ months out:** Begin testing creative messages and building audience data

facts.fact: Adwave recommends peak programmatic spending in the final 8 weeks before Election Day.
facts.quote: Final 8 weeks:** Peak spending with proven messages and targeting

facts.fact: Adwave describes the pre-peak period as 6-8 weeks before Election Day, when spending should increase.
facts.quote: Pre-peak (6-8 weeks out):** Increase spending and shift toward proven performers.

facts.fact: Adwave describes the peak period as the final 4 weeks before Election Day, with maximum spending weight.
facts.quote: Peak period (final 4 weeks):** Maximum spending weight.

facts.quote: Major platforms (Google, Meta) restrict microtargeting for political ads.

facts.fact: Adwave states some states require disclosure of targeting criteria for political programmatic campaigns.
facts.quote: Some states require disclosure of targeting criteria. Maintain detailed records.

facts.fact: Adwave notes programmatic display offers lower CPMs than video, enabling high-frequency campaigns on limited budgets.
facts.quote: Display advertising offers lower CPMs than video, enabling high-frequency campaigns and broad reach on limited budgets.

facts.fact: Political programmatic campaigns commonly set frequency caps of about 3-5 impressions per day per household to prevent ad fatigue.
facts.quote: Set caps to prevent ad fatigue (typically 3-5 impressions per day per household).

facts.fact: The page states that for local races, $5,000-10,000 over 4-6 weeks can deliver meaningful reach in a district.
facts.quote: For local races, $5,000-10,000 over 4-6 weeks can deliver meaningful reach in a district.

facts.fact: The page states that state legislative races typically need $25,000-100,000 for competitive impact in programmatic political advertising.
facts.quote: State legislative races typically need $25,000-100,000 for competitive impact.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its self-serve platform lets campaigns start programmatic CTV buying with as little as $30 a day.
facts.quote: Self-serve platforms like Adwave enable campaigns to start with as little as $30 a day for CTV.

facts.fact: The page states that programmatic match rates for voter file records typically range 50-70% of voters on platforms that are active on programmatic-enabled inventory.
facts.quote: Match rates typically range 50-70%, meaning you'll reach roughly two-thirds of the voters on your list
